steps.sql: DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),32766-1)+N'0]'; SELECT @s=N'{'+STRING_AGG(CAST(N'"k'+[key]+N'":0' AS nvarchar(max)),N',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY CAST([key] AS int))+N'}' FROM OPENJSON(@s); DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes; BEGIN TRY SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.new',1); SELECT 1 AS succeeded; END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS n,ERROR_STATE() AS s,ERROR_SEVERITY() AS severity; END CATCH; SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.new') AS new_value;
